function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Ji Sung Park (박지성)** – South Korean actor

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Birth** | March 12 1979, Seoul, South Korea |
| **Education** | Seoul Institute of the Arts – Department of Theater & Film |
| **Years Active** | 2001–present |
| **Agent** | C-JeS Entertainment (as of 2024) |

---

### Early Life & Education
- Born into a family that valued the arts; his father was a theater director.
- Studied acting at the Seoul Institute of the Arts, where he honed his craft in both stage and screen.

### Career Highlights

| Year | Project | Role | Notes |
|------|---------|------|-------|
| 2001 | *The Great Seer* (TV) | Supporting | First major TV appearance |
| 2005 | *The King of Pigs* (Film) | Lead | Break‑through role; earned critical acclaim |
| 2007 | *The King of Pigs* (TV series) | Lead | Adaptation of the film; solidified his status as a leading man |
| 2010 | *The King of Pigs* (Film) | Lead | Sequel; further cemented his reputation |
| 2014 | *The King of Pigs* (TV) | Lead | Third adaptation; showcased his range |
| 2019 | *The Great Seer* (TV) | Lead | Return to the series that launched his career |
| 2020 | *The King: Eternal Monarch* (TV) | Lead | International hit; increased global visibility |
| 2021 | *The King: Eternal Monarch* (Film) | Lead | Film adaptation of the series |
| 2022 | *The King: Eternal Monarch* (TV) | Lead | Final season; concluded a multi‑year saga |

### Awards & Recognition
- **Baeksang Arts Awards** – Nominated for Best Actor (multiple years)
- **Korean Film Awards** – Best Actor (for *The King of Pigs*)
- **Korean Drama Awards** – Best Actor (for *The King: Eternal Monarch*)
- **Asia Pacific Screen Awards** – Best Performance (for *The King: Eternal Monarch*)

### Personal Life
- Married fellow actress **Kim Hye‑so** in 2015; the couple has one son (born 2017).
- Known for his disciplined work ethic and commitment to character research.
- Active in philanthropic efforts, particularly in education and arts programs for underprivileged youth.

### Notable Traits
- **Versatility**: Successfully portrays a wide range of characters—from historical figures to contemporary protagonists.
- **Physicality**: Often performs his own stunts and action sequences, especially in period dramas.
- **Public Image**: Maintains a low‑profile personal life while being highly respected in the industry.

---

#### Quick Facts
- **Height:** 180 cm (5 11 in)
- **Languages:** Korean (native), English (conversational)
- **Social Media:** Active on Instagram (@jiseongpark) and Twitter (@jiseongpark)

---

**Why He Matters**  
Ji Sung Park is considered one of South Korea’s most reliable leading actors. His consistent performances across film and television have earned him a loyal fan base both domestically and internationally. His work on *The King: Eternal Monarch* introduced him to a global audience, solidifying his status as a cross‑border star.
